title: M2 doctor and architecture snapshot diff
scope: AEGS local diagnostics and read-only architecture comparison
alternatives: Keep manual verification and compare JSON snapshots by hand
impact: Adds read-only CLI diagnostics; does not change production permissions
counter_evidence: Diagnostics may give a false sense of security if treated as authentication or immutable audit
acceptance_criteria: Doctor flags stale handoff and snapshot diff reports added, removed, and changed files
evidence_refs: USR-20261115: user requested continued M2 development
rollback_reference: Revert the M2 implementation commit and regenerate architecture and handoff artifacts.
